idea-plugin.name: Spring Inspector
idea-plugin.description:
Offline code inspector for Java, Spring Boot and Spring AI projects.

Gives your project a report card covering security, Spring Boot and Spring AI rules, clean code, migrations and vulnerable dependencies. Every finding says what is wrong, why it matters and how to fix it.

  • Run it on the whole project or on your staged changes from the Spring Inspector tool window, or with Tools | Inspect Project with Spring Inspector.
  • Findings are underlined in the editor with a gutter icon; Alt+Enter applies the fix, with a preview.
  • Commits made from the IDE are checked first, like the git hook does.
  • Double-click a finding to open it in the editor.
  • Your code never leaves your machine: the inspector runs locally, in its own process.

Needs Java 25 or newer to run the inspector: the IDE's own Java when it is new enough, or one you choose in Settings | Tools | Spring Inspector.

action.description: Runs Spring Inspector on the whole project and shows its report card
